title: Write your lyrics in Gemini to match the story, then paste a Seedance 2.0…
content: Write your lyrics in Gemini to match the story, then paste a Seedance 2.0 prompt block that specifies genre/energy, exact BPM, key (e.g., E Minor), language, and include an instruction like The woman lip-syncs the lyrics precisely to sync lip movements to the lyrics.
tips: Write your lyrics in Gemini to match the story, then paste a Seedance 2.0 prompt block that specifies genre/energy, exact BPM, key (e.g., E Minor), language, and include an instruction like The woman lip-syncs the lyrics precisely to sync lip movements to the lyrics.

es.content: Escribe tus letras en Gemini para que coincidan con la historia, luego pega un bloque de prompt de Seedance 2.0 que especifique género/energía, BPM exacto, tonalidad (por ejemplo, Mi menor), idioma, e incluye una instrucción como La mujer sincroniza los labios con las letras precisamente para sincronizar los movimientos labiales con las letras.

fr.content: Écrivez vos paroles en Gemini pour correspondre à l'histoire, puis collez un bloc de prompt Seedance 2.0 qui spécifie le genre/l'énergie, le BPM exact, la tonalité (par exemple, Mi mineur), la langue, et incluez une instruction comme The woman lip-syncs the lyrics precisely to sync lip movements to the lyrics.

ja.content:
---
物語に合わせてGeminiで歌詞を書き、その後にSeedance 2.0のプロンプトブロックを貼り付けてください。そこにはジャンル/エネルギー、正確なBPM、キー（例：E Minor）、言語を指定し、The woman lip-syncs the lyrics precisely to sync lip movements to the lyricsのような指示を含めてください。

ko.content: Gemini에 맞춰 가사를 작성한 후, Seedance 2.0 프롬프트 블록을 붙여넣으세요. 이 프롬프트 블록에는 장르/에너지, 정확한 BPM, 키 (예: E Minor), 언어를 지정하고, "The woman lip-syncs the lyrics precisely to sync lip movements to the lyrics"와 같은 지시사항을 포함하세요.

pt.content: Escreva suas letras em Gemini para combinar com a história, depois cole um bloco de prompt Seedance 2.0 que especifique gênero/energia, BPM exato, tonalidade (por exemplo, Mi Menor), idioma, e inclua uma instrução como A mulher dubla as letras precisamente para sincronizar os movimentos labiais com as letras.

zh.content: 用双子座写下你的歌词以匹配故事，然后粘贴一个Seedance 2.0 prompt块，指定类型/能量、确切的BPM、调（例如，E小调）、语言，并包括一个指令，如The woman lip-syncs the lyrics precisely to sync lip movements to the lyrics。
